iteration_summaries.hypothesis: The system has a MODULAR MULTIPLICATIVE structure with clear output-specific drivers. Y3=f(X1*X3) exclusively with strong product synergy (R²≈0.98). Y4=g(X2*X4, X6) with X2*X4 synergy (+) and X6 additive (-). Y1=complex(all inputs) with X2*X4 as dominant multiplicative mechanism (+0.678), X1*X4 secondary synergy (+0.271), X5 step gate (adds ~0.378, transition X5=0.28-0.64), and X6 inversely modulated by X2 and gated by X5. Y2=h(X1,X2,X3,X4,X6) with X2*X6 sign-reversal (crossover ~X2=0.75-0.80), X2*X4 regime-dependence, and X3 purely additive negative. Pareto frontier parameterized by (X2, X6) with X1=X3=X4=1, X5≥0.6 fixed as universally beneficial. Final HV=0.2794 with 60 Pareto points. Model predictions confirmed across 30+ targeted evaluations with <3% error on nearly all outputs, validating extremely high model fidelity.
